%doc: Vehicles that ride inside or dock on other ships, for the Vehicles page (Carries / Fits inside). Neither UEX nor the Star Citizen Wiki's API has this as data, so it's kept here by hand: only pairs CIG builds the ship around (a snub dock, a garage that comes with a vehicle). Names are matched against UEX's full names, case and spacing ignored. Add a pair as 'carrier': ['vehicle', ...].
